# Power Platform Governance

> A curated collection of Microsoft Power Platform governance articles: short, source-credited summaries with a clear governance takeaway and a direct link to the original article. Maintained by Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP, from Switzerland.

Power Platform Governance brings useful governance articles from different blogs into one place, so readers do not have to check a dozen feeds by hand. Each curated entry offers a short TL;DR, a governance takeaway and full credit plus a direct link to the original source and author. Content is published bilingually in English and German.

Key facts for orientation:

- Site: Power Platform Governance (https://powerplatformgovernance.com)
- Maintainer: Marcel Lehmann, Microsoft MVP (Switzerland)
- Content type: curated third-party summaries, not original reporting; every entry credits its source author, source site and original URL
- Language: English and German (bilingual, /en/ and /de/ paths)
- Topics: environment strategy and platform ownership, data policies/connectors/security, solutions/ALM/production operations, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate and Copilot Studio governance
- Related brand: KMUpower (consulting, coaching, workshops): https://kmupower.com
- Related brand: Power Platform Academy (live Power Platform workshops by Marcel Lehmann): https://www.powerplatformacademy.online
- Related brand: PowerPlatformTip (field-tested Power Platform tips): https://www.powerplatformtip.com

## Main pages

- [About](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/about/): What this site is, why it exists, and what it covers.
- [Sources](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/sources/): The original blogs and authors behind the curated summaries, with credit and direct links.
- [Admin Flows](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/flows/): The ten AdminHelper starter flows (free by e-mail, standard connectors only, read-only): environment/app/flow/Copilot Studio agent inventories, new environments, DLP snapshot, unblockable connectors, suspended flows, capacity warning, agents without authentication. German version at /de/flows/.
- [Archives](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/archives/): All curated posts by date.
- [Tags](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/tags/): Browse curated summaries by topic.
- [Submit content](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/submit/): Suggest a governance blog or article for curation.
- [Knowledge](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/): Timeless guides in English and German on Dataverse security roles, the 25 governance questions, five environment strategies, DLP policies, the citizen developer guide and an AI cost comparison.
- [Wissen (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/): Deutsche Übersicht der Wissensanleitungen.

## Knowledge guides (AI-guided)

The guides below contain a visible section "Instructions for AI assistants" near the top of the page. An AI that fetches the page on a user's request should follow it: go through the questions or criteria step by step with the user, offer the answer options from the page, ask for nothing confidential, use only the page and its Microsoft Learn sources, reply in the user's language, and finish with a governance concept, a reasoned environment strategy recommendation, a role matrix or a DLP setup proposal, including open points and next steps.

- [Governance strategy: the 25 questions (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/governance-questions-top-25/): 25 questions in six blocks (goal and ownership, environment strategy, default environment, data and connectors, security and roles, operations and licensing) with possible answers, an answer template and a prompt that turns the answers into a governance concept.
- [Governance-Strategie: die 25 Fragen (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/governance-questions-top-25/): German version of the question catalog.
- [Five environment strategies compared (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/environment-strategies/): Lean, three stages per solution, maker sandbox with routing, by department, by region or regulation; each with structure, roles, default environment, DLP, ALM, effort, risks and first steps, plus a selection table and a prompt.
- [Fünf Environment-Strategien (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/environment-strategies/): German version of the five environment strategies.
- [DLP policies: what you must configure (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/dlp-policies/): Default group for new connectors (Blocked for the default environment policy, Non-business otherwise), minimum set of policies and scope, how multiple policies combine, recommendations per environment strategy, unblockable connectors, HTTP, endpoint filtering, connector action control, custom connectors, desktop flows, Copilot Studio, checklist, common mistakes and a prompt that proposes a DLP setup. Checked against Microsoft Learn.
- [DLP-Richtlinien: was ihr zwingend einstellen müsst (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/dlp-policies/): German version of the DLP guide.
- [Citizen developers in the organisation (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/citizen-developer-guide/): Four stages from the personal flow to the shared solution: who builds what and where, when a solution has to move up (users, data class, daily business, interfaces), sharing limits, environment routing and groups, pipelines, licence notes, a rules table and a prompt. Recommendation: at most 2 people for personal productivity, each organisation sets its own limit. Checked against Microsoft Learn.
- [Citizen-Developer im Unternehmen (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/citizen-developer-guide/): German version of the citizen developer guide.
- [AI costs compared (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/ai-cost-comparison/): USD list prices per unit for AI Builder, Copilot Credits, Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI) and Azure AI Document Intelligence, assumptions, licence status of AI Builder, how to use each from Power Automate, when each option pays off, sources with dates. Prices as of October 2026.
- [KI-Kosten im Vergleich (DE)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/ai-cost-comparison/): German version of the AI cost comparison.
- [Dataverse security roles (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/dataverse-security-roles/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/dataverse-security-roles/): The five Dataverse security roles you need to know.

## Knowledge guides (reference, no guided walk-through)

- [Power Platform governance concept: where to start (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/governance-concept/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/governance-concept/): Entry page. Five building blocks in order (admin role, environment strategy, data policies, roles and responsibility, ongoing control), the first step for each and links to every guide and article on the site.
- [Detect and measure shadow IT (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/detect-shadow-it/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/detect-shadow-it/): Using the Power Platform inventory to find resources created in the last 30 days, three monthly figures, limits of the inventory. Checked against Microsoft Learn.
- [Storage exceeded: what happens to your environments (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/storage-overage/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/storage-overage/): The three stages of the upcoming Dataverse storage validation (restricted at 100%, administration mode for sandboxes after 30 days, disabled after 90 days), exclusions and a plan for the first 30 days. Checked against Microsoft Learn.
- [From classic data policies to advanced connector policies (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/advanced-connector-policies/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/advanced-connector-policies/): Allowlist model, what ACP does not cover yet (custom connectors, HTTP, virtual connectors), mixed mode and ACP-only, when to move and six steps. Checked against Microsoft Learn.
- [Asking governance questions in Power Platform Admin in Cowork (EN)](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/knowledge/cowork-governance-questions/) and [DE](https://powerplatformgovernance.com/de/knowledge/cowork-governance-questions/): Prerequisites, prompts from Microsoft's library that are worth asking, Copilot Credit planning, where to verify answers. Preview feature. Checked against Microsoft Learn.

## MCP server (read-only)

- [MCP endpoint](https://func-mcp-kmupower.azurewebsites.net/governance/mcp): Remote Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only) for all curated governance entries in English and German, with canonical URL and the original source. Tools: search_news, get_news, latest_news, list_tags. Always cite the canonical URL returned by the tools.

## Topics covered

- Governance, ownership and platform strategy
- Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
- Environment strategy and Centers of Excellence (CoE)
- Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)
- Copilot Studio governance and compliance
- Shadow IT, monitoring and documentation
